name: Hide Jira Recent and Recommended Menus
description: Automatically hides the 'Recent' and 'Recommended' dropdown sections in Jira navigation menus to provide a cleaner, less cluttered interface. This extension only modifies the visual display of navigation elements on Atlassian Jira sites and does not collect, store, or transmit any user data. No permissions beyond website access are required.
author: Hadrien
